title: Bowel prep for colonoscopy
what: So the doctor can see the whole bowel, it must be fully cleaned with a special solution. Good prep decides whether the test works.
why: Before a colonoscopy, and sometimes before surgery or some X-ray tests of the bowel.
duration: 3 days of diet, plus one evening and morning of cleansing
tell_doctor: If you have diabetes. Your food and medicine plan will be different
Constipation. You may need a longer prep
Iron tablets. You are usually asked to pause them, but the doctor decides

prepare.title: 3 days before
prepare.text: You can eat: white bread, rice, pasta, boiled meat and fish, eggs, cottage cheese. Avoid: vegetables, fruit, berries, leafy greens, seeds, nuts, beans, and whole grain cereals.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: A light breakfast, then clear liquids only: water, strained broth, tea without milk, clear juice without pulp.

prepare.title: The solution
prepare.text: Mix and drink it exactly as your product's instructions and your doctor say. Usually one glass every 15 to 20 minutes.

prepare.title: Tips
prepare.text: Chilled solution is easier to drink. You can follow it with a clear drink. Walk around the house. It helps it work faster.

bring: Wet wipes and skin cream. You will want them at home
steps: The evening before, drink the first part of the solution within the time in your plan
In 1 to 2 hours, frequent watery stools will start. Stay near a toilet
Early in the morning, drink the second part, if you have a two-part plan
Finish drinking 3 to 4 hours before the colonoscopy, or by your clinic's deadline
You are ready when your stool is a clear yellow liquid with no bits
feel: You may feel sick, bloated, or chilly. Drink more slowly
Going to the toilet often is the cleansing working
after: If your stool still has bits in it, tell the clinic before the test
red_flags: Severe belly pain, vomiting again and again, sudden weakness or dizziness: contact your clinic or call emergency services

faq.q: What if I cannot finish the solution?
faq.a: Drink more slowly, chill it, and take a 20 to 30 minute break. If you still cannot, call your clinic.

faq.q: Can I eat during the prep?
faq.a: After breakfast the day before, clear liquids only. Otherwise the bowel will not be clean.

reminders.text: Start your low-fiber diet: no vegetables, fruit, seeds, or whole grains.
After breakfast today, clear liquids only. In the evening, drink the solution as planned.
